scripts.build: cargo run --locked -p cna-map --bin map-census -- --release-check --bundle-dir public && npm run wasm && vite build && cargo run --locked -p cna-map --bin map-census -- --release-check
scripts.test:e2e: npm run check:guards && npm run test:browser --
scripts.test:sources: npm run check:sources && cargo test --workspace --locked --release -- --ignored && npm run test:source-data
scripts.check:guards: bash scripts/check-no-credentials.sh && cargo run --locked -p cna-map --bin map-census -- --release-check --bundle-dir public && cargo run --locked -p cna-map --bin map-census -- --release-check
scripts.lint: npm run lint:rust && npm run lint:scripts
scripts.lint:rust: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p cna-frontend -- -D warnings
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.check:ci: npm run check && npm run test:e2e
